changelog: With WooCommerce's 'Reviews can only be left by verified owners' ticked, only verified buyers can review. Others see a note in place of the form, and their reviews are refused.
The Tools page's Photo Reviews counts read right in the singular.
Reviews from the product page's form by signed-in buyers are marked Verified buyer. The form sent no REST nonce, so WordPress treated every product-page review as a guest's.
